name: ExpandableSearch
description: A circular search button that springs open into a full-width search field, submitting on Enter and collapsing on Escape with focus handed back to the toggle.
a11yNotes: Rendered as a <form role="search">; the toggle is a <button type="button"> with aria-label, aria-expanded and aria-controls, and the input carries aria-label="Search". Opening moves focus into the input, Escape collapses and returns focus to the toggle, Enter calls onSearch. The collapsed input is hidden from the tab order. prefers-reduced-motion makes the width change instant.

propsApi.name: onSearch
propsApi.description: Called with the current query when Enter is pressed.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
